statements.t: “With substantial reductions in headcount and expenses, combined with two launches and continued growth in our base business, we expect meaningful profitability in 2027 and going forward.”
The company reaffirms its full year 2026 total revenue guidance of $730 million to $760 million, which excludes revenue from new product launches.
The company reaffirms its full year 2026 Crysvita revenue guidance of $500 million to $520 million.
The company reaffirms its full year 2026 Dojolvi revenue guidance of $100 million to $110 million.

To support this transition, the company has initiated substantial headcount and expense reductions and expects to reduce 2027 R&D expenses to less than $350 million and 2027 SG&A expenses to less than $375 million.
The company continues to anticipate achieving full-year GAAP profitability in 2027 and going forward.
The company will continue to engage regulatory agencies to determine the necessary data to support a regulatory filing and if there is a potential path forward for UX143.
The live and replayed webcast of the call will be available through the company’s website at https://ir.ultragenyx.com/events-presentations.
